subject.title: fix(wechat): preserve existing accounts across hot reload

question: After the configuration-preservation defect is fixed, should a live WeChat A+B QR-login continuity run be required before merge, or is the focused gateway regression proof sufficient for this lifecycle change?
rationale: Only someone with the relevant provider setup or repository authority can decide whether gateway-level lifecycle coverage substitutes for a live external-provider session.

options.title: Require redacted live proof
options.body: Require an observed A+B WeChat login/reload run showing that account A remains available after account B is added.

options.title: Accept gateway-level proof
options.body: Explicitly waive live provider proof and rely on the focused lifecycle regression coverage once the plugin-reload configuration guard is repaired.

recommendation.title: Require redacted live proof
recommendation.body: Require an observed A+B WeChat login/reload run showing that account A remains available after account B is added.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work on the shared account-reload lifecycle makes this the strongest available adjacent routing signal.
